purpose: Post-selection semantic pruning, never replace Place Affinity with sparse containment matrix
notes: Generic other Site↔Zone and Site↔Location relationships stay governed by the original locked symmetric Book1 affinity, not C-v6.
Filtered child Locations are returned to the exact parent container as direct locations, never silently deleted from the generated world.
If Site parent Zone compatibility fails, cancel whole Site and return every child direct to original container.
If Site has fewer than two eligible child Locations after pruning, cancel and restore all children.
Standalone City pools must retain existing City Score eligibility; these family filters do not change it.
Filter checks only post-Site grouping; political placement and location selection are NOT modified.
Dock→Ship accepted as berth adjacency not literal inside-building; allowed site children represent one coherent dock compound.
Site filters for Farm/Dock/Shipyard are whitelist; core Location filters apply only to Farm/Ship/Dock when they appear under any other Site.
Direct Location→Zone affinity is intentionally not changed here, except cross-family zeroes already handled in political exception separately.

Shipyard may contain a sawmill (Mill) for timber and a sailmaking workshop (Tailor); dock compound may host workers Camp. Do not forbid plausible historical craft/logistics facilities merely because they are unusual.
